lines: {target}? Sound itself can <shake>wake trouble</shake>. I would keep rope dry and a boat tied.
If anyone heads for Ancient City, tell them: <pulse>Step softly</pulse> and leave the shiny things alone. I will be at the barrel.
Sculk does not need eyes to notice you. I will remember that when I coil the rope.
Ancient City is no small story. Deep trouble does not always look deep.
I will remember Ancient City as a city where <pulse>silence matters</pulse> more than armor. I will keep a rope ready.
